class Student:
    def __init__(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        self._pupil = None
        self._ta = None

    def setNumber(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        return True

    def getNumber(self):
        return self._number

    def getPupil(self):
        return self._pupil

    def hasPupil(self):
        return self._pupil is not None

    def getTa(self):
        return self._ta

    def hasTa(self):
        return self._ta is not None

    def setPupil(self, aNewPupil):
        if aNewPupil is None:
            existingPupil = self._pupil
            self._pupil = None
            if existingPupil is not None and existingPupil.getTa() is not None:
                existingPupil.setTa(None)
            return True
        currentPupil = self._pupil
        if currentPupil is not None and currentPupil is not aNewPupil:
            currentPupil.setTa(None)
        self._pupil = aNewPupil
        existingTa = aNewPupil.getTa()
        if existingTa is not self:
            aNewPupil.setTa(self)
        return True

    def setTa(self, aNewTa):
        if aNewTa is None:
            existingTa = self._ta
            self._ta = None
            if existingTa is not None and existingTa.getPupil() is not None:
                existingTa.setPupil(None)
            return True
        currentTa = self._ta
        if currentTa is not None and currentTa is not aNewTa:
            currentTa.setPupil(None)
        self._ta = aNewTa
        existingPupil = aNewTa.getPupil()
        if existingPupil is not self:
            aNewTa.setPupil(self)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        if self._pupil is not None:
            self._pupil.setTa(None)
        if self._ta is not None:
            self._ta.setPupil(None)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "number:" + str(self.getNumber())
                + "]")
